title: How to Embed sharethis Share Buttons
breadcrumbs: How to Embed sharethis Share Buttons
content:
## How to Embed sharethis Share Buttons


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059410

This article covers how to embed third-party ShareThis social media share buttons.


## How to Receive the Code


To embed ShareThis share buttons on web pages, first navigate to https://sharethis.com/ .

Then click on Start with Share Buttons :

Choose from the sharing button options and click on Next :

Important Note: Before clicking Next, customize the share buttons further by clicking "Customize your share buttons":

Drag and order these buttons:

Add or remove buttons:

It is also possible to further customize the design and settings:

After customizing the buttons, click Next . When asked to specify the platform, choose the HTML option and click Next :

Log in or sign up to receive the code, then click Get The Code :

This displays the installation guide for HTML:


## How to Embed the Code On Static Pages


To embed the code on static pages, copy the first code:

Paste it into the website's Additional HEAD Code section, under Settings >> Design Settings >> Custom CSS/HEAD :

Then copy the second code:

Navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager and click New Widget :

Create the new widget with the second code:

Copy the new widget's Shortcode :

With the widget's shortcode, call these buttons on any page. Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder then click Edit on an existing page or click New Web Page to create a new one:

And simply paste the code in the text editor section:

The buttons will appear on the front-end page immediately:
